quote.heading: Tell us what you want inked
quote.intro: Fill this out and we'll get back to you with a price. The more detail you give, the faster and more accurate your quote will be.
quote.timingNote: how long an order takes depends on how busy we are. We'll let you know when yours can be ready when we send your quote.

form.itemsQuestion: What do you want printed? Pick all that apply.
form.itemsHint: Each item you pick gets its own section below for sizes, colors and print details.
form.uploadHint: Logos, photos, sketches or examples you like. Up to 5 files. Big photos are shrunk automatically so they send. If you upload a picture, it shows up on the shirt below so you can drag it where you want it.
form.linesQuestionSized: What do you need? Add one line for each color and size.
form.linesQuestion: What do you need? Add one line for each color.
form.sizesHint: Example: 2 black men's L on one line, 3 white women's M on the next, 1 orange kids S on the next. Kids sizes are youth sizes.
form.spotsQuestion: Where should the print go? Drag the tiki (or your uploaded design) onto the picture, or tap a spot below.
form.spotsQuestionNoPicture: Where should the print go? Pick all that apply.
form.notSureMethod: We'll pick the best one for your design.
form.sublimationWarning: Dye sublimation doesn't work on cotton. Pick polyester, or switch to DTF.
form.artQuestion: Do you have artwork or pictures?
form.missingMessage: Almost there. Please add your name, a way to reach you, and at least one line with how many for each item you picked.
form.reviewHeading: Check your request, then hit Send:
form.sendHint: Your request and any artwork you uploaded go straight to Tiki T's.
form.sentMessage: Thanks! We got your quote request. We'll email you your quote with the price as soon as we see it.
